title: China 2030: Building a Modern, Harmonious, and Creative Society
coverage: Independent joint World Bank and Chinese Development Research Center retrospective on the CCP's reform path from 1978, decentralised experimentation, market transition, growth, institutional constraints, and reform tradeoffs

title: John Hus: A Brief Story of the Life of a Martyr
coverage: Independent biographical account of Hus's early influences, institutional opposition, exile, Council of Constance trial, condemnation, execution, and immediate reform legacy

title: Cetywayo and His White Neighbours
coverage: Contemporary account challenging parts of British policy toward Cetshwayo and Zululand, including Zulu state formation, the 1879 invasion, the postwar partition, civil conflict, and the restoration debate

title: Islam
coverage: Muslim-authored interpretation of the early caliphate restricted to the succession after Muhammad, Uthman's death, Ali's accession, the rebellions against him, his assassination, Hasan's renunciation, and Umayyad consolidation

title: Historical Tales, Volume VIII: Russian
coverage: Independent popular account restricted to the Trans-Caspian railway and the Russian assault on the Tekke stronghold at Geok Tepe, including the massacre, submission, and colonial consolidation
